candidates.rationale: A whole-system feed, and on route count alone it looks like a clear upgrade on either registered feed. Its trip IDs resolved 0 of 48 against the registered realtime, while the Availtec static resolved 48 of 48. Its calendar also ended 2026-10-04 against 2027-12-31 for both registered feeds. Registering the Availtec and Passio feeds together covers the same system with working realtime and a longer horizon. Worth reconsidering if the calendar is renewed and the trip IDs come to match the realtime.

Passio publishes no realtime for this tenant. All three realtime paths return 404 while the static on the same slug serves normally, so this is tenant configuration rather than a wrong slug. citrusconn is the only slug that resolves; citrusconnection, citrus, lamtd, polk, polktransit and ridecitrus all 404 on the static as well.
